name: Pololu D36V28F5 5 V step-down regulator
description: 5 V, 3.2 A synchronous buck module for up to 50 V in, with enable, power-good and reverse protection: good for 24–36 V robots and 10S packs.

kicad.footprintNote: Ready-made module: wire it up with a connector or header

notes: 3.2 A typical max at 36 V in; 2.5–4 A depending on input voltage.
Power-save mode stays above 20 kHz (no audible whine).

terminals.name: EN
terminals.note: Enabled by default: 100 kΩ on-board pull-up to VIN. Below 1.2 V the regulator sleeps; above 1.35 V it turns back on. Sleep draws about 10-20 µA per volt on VIN. The tight threshold lets an external divider from VIN act as a precise low-battery cutoff.

terminals.name: VIN
terminals.note: Silkscreen 'IN'. Up to 50 V; effective minimum is VOUT + dropout (5.3 V headline minimum).

terminals.name: PG
terminals.note: Not on the edge row: second-row pad right next to EN, on the 0.1 in grid. Open-drain output that goes low when VOUT is more than 20% above or more than 10% below nominal (with hysteresis). Needs an external pull-up resistor.

notes: Edge row order is EN, IN, GND, GND, OUT. PG sits off the edge, beside EN. The labels are printed on the bottom side.
Includes a 6x1 straight header and a 5x1 right-angle header. One pin of the straight header can be broken off and soldered into PG.
Dropout for the 5 V version, read from Pololu's dropout graph (not stated in text): about 0.9 V at 0.5 A, 1.1 V at 2 A, 1.35 V at 3.2 A and 1.55 V at 4 A.
Reverse-voltage protection up to 40 V, which is below the 50 V input maximum.
Has output undervoltage and overvoltage protection, over-current and short-circuit protection, thermal shutdown and soft-start.
No-load quiescent current 2-3 mA typical. Light-load power-save mode keeps the switching frequency above 20 kHz (ultrasonic). Switching frequency is about 500 kHz under heavy load.
Maximum continuous current is about 4 A at about 7-12 V in, 3.2 A at 36 V in, and about 2.5 A at 48 V in (Pololu graph, still air, room temperature).
Can get hot enough to burn you during normal operation.
Two 2.18 mm mounting holes for M2 or #2 screws.

summary: 5.3–50 V in → 5 V fixed, 3.2 A, 500 kHz
